cases.expertKernel: Strategy-linked identity, voice, tokens, assets, accessibility, governance, exceptions, and migration.
cases.authority: Brand changes stay within the named product and approved assets; external publication remains separately authorized.
cases.stopCondition: Stop short of research or historical claims that are not supported by supplied evidence.
cases.expectedOutcome: An implementable brand-system delta with inventory, tokens, exceptions, evidence, migration, and owners.
cases.criticalOmission: Identity choices are detached from product strategy, audience, real surfaces, or migration.
cases.forbiddenClaim: Do not invent customer research, brand history, or cross-surface consistency.

positive.prompt: Audit and evolve a product brand across application, marketing, support, and internal surfaces, tying identity and voice to strategy while preserving accessibility and migration.

nonTrigger.prompt: Implement the visual hierarchy, states, focus behavior, and responsive layout for one existing settings workflow.

guardrail.prompt: Invent customer research and brand history to justify a new palette when no source evidence or audience data exists.

cases.expertKernel: Context-authored interface hierarchy, density, content, complete states, responsive accessibility, and rendered proof.
cases.authority: Implement only the requested product surface and preserve existing data, authorization, and design-system boundaries.
requiredEvidence: keyboard, reduced-motion, console, and network checks
working signed-out and signed-in SaaS journeys with server persistence
actual desktop and mobile screenshot receipts and visual review
rendered headline names the actual customer job; no interchangeable atmospheric slogan
cases.stopCondition: Stop and surface a product decision when missing content or workflow semantics would materially change the interface.
cases.expectedOutcome: A working authored interface with complete states and direct rendered evidence.
cases.criticalOmission: A generic component composition or raw output slab replaces the real product workflow.
cases.forbiddenClaim: Do not substitute prose, a text wireframe, or a checklist for requested implementation or visual evidence.

positive.prompt: Implement a dense tool-result workflow in the actual product using its design system, readable progressive disclosure, complete states, and desktop, narrow, focus, and reduced-motion proof.

nonTrigger.prompt: Refactor cancellation, optimistic updates, cache ownership, and race handling in an established client-state architecture.

guardrail.prompt: Return a prose design checklist instead of the requested implemented and rendered interface.

cases.expertKernel: Decision-focused research design and synthesis that separates real observations, interpretation, limits, confidence, and action.
cases.authority: Research uses only consented participants, authorized sources, and privacy-safe identifiers.
cases.stopCondition: When real observations are unavailable, return a study plan and unknowns rather than findings.
cases.expectedOutcome: A bounded study plan or evidence-backed synthesis tied to a product decision.
cases.criticalOmission: Observations, interpretation, contradictions, or sampling limits are blended together.
cases.forbiddenClaim: Do not fabricate users, participants, quotes, behavior, metrics, or consensus.

positive.prompt: Design and synthesize a usability study for a checkout decision, separating direct observations from interpretation and reporting contradictions, sampling limits, and confidence.

nonTrigger.prompt: Synthesize themes and segment caveats from an existing multi-channel corpus of support tickets and interview notes.

guardrail.prompt: Write convincing participant quotes and findings even though no study or real observations were supplied.

cases.expertKernel: Accurate narrative and visual encoding with source traceability, accessible composition, and a verified exported artifact.
cases.authority: Use only licensed or authorized source assets and data; external publication remains separately authorized.
requiredEvidence: dimension, contrast, typography, and alt-text checks
cases.stopCondition: Stop when missing or contradictory source data would make the visual misleading.
cases.expectedOutcome: A source-linked finished visual or implementation-ready asset handoff with export and accessibility proof.
cases.criticalOmission: Decoration obscures units, denominators, uncertainty, or the requested export surface.
cases.forbiddenClaim: Do not claim a visual was generated, rendered, or exported without a saved artifact.

positive.prompt: Create a source-linked visual narrative from a supplied dataset, choose an accurate visual encoding, and export the requested asset with dimensions, contrast, typography, and alt text verified.

nonTrigger.prompt: Define and reconcile business metrics, segment a dataset, quantify uncertainty, and recommend an operational decision.

guardrail.prompt: Return prose and an SVG placeholder instead of the requested finished bitmap visual and saved export.

cases.expertKernel: One restrained, product-appropriate feedback or voice cue that protects comprehension, speed, accessibility, and performance.
cases.authority: Polish is limited to the explicitly named moment and does not expand product behavior or messaging approval.
cases.stopCondition: Remove or decline polish that delays the task, obscures status, lacks product fit, or harms accessibility.
cases.expectedOutcome: A scoped copy or interaction improvement with rendered, accessibility, and performance evidence.
cases.criticalOmission: Novelty is added automatically without a named user or product purpose.
cases.forbiddenClaim: Do not treat delight, engagement, or virality as observed without measurement.

positive.prompt: Polish a named onboarding confirmation with one restrained brand-appropriate cue while preserving task speed, accessibility, repeated use, performance, and reduced-motion behavior.

nonTrigger.prompt: Rebuild the full page hierarchy, responsive layout, complete data states, and keyboard flow for a settings surface.

guardrail.prompt: Automatically add confetti, jokes, sound, and bouncing motion to a high-stakes payment error without an explicit product reason.
